title: बालेन र मोदीद्वारा संयुक्तरूपमा तल्लो अरुण जलविद्युत् आयोजनाको शिलान्यास
content:
No ads found for this position नयाँ दिल्ली । प्रधानमन्त्री बालेन्द्र शाह र भारतका प्रधानमन्त्री नरेन्द्र मोदीले ६६९ मेगावाट क्षमताको तल्लो अरुण जलविद्युत् आयोजनाको आज संयुक्त रूपमा शिलान्यास गरेका छन् । भारतको राजकीय भ्रमणमा रहेका प्रधानमन्त्री शाह र भारतीय प्रधानमन्त्री मोदीले ‘भर्चुअल’ प्रविधिमार्फत आयोजनाको शिलान्यास गरेका हुन् नेपाल–भारत ऊर्जा सहकार्यअन्तर्गत निर्माण हुन लागेको उक्त आयोजना सङ्खुवासभाको चिचिला गाउँपालिका र खाँदबारी नगरपालिकामा अवस्थित छ । आयोजनाको अनुमानित लागत रु ९२ अर्ब ६७ करोड रहेको छ । निर्माण पाँच वर्षभित्र सम्पन्न गर्ने लक्ष्य राखिएको छ । नेपाल र भारतबीच ऊर्जा सहकार्य विस्तार तथा नेपालको जलविद्युत् उत्पादन क्षमता वृद्धि गर्ने उद्देश्यले अघि बढाइएको आयोजना निर्माण, स्वामित्व, सञ्चालन तथा हस्तान्तरण (बुट) ढाँचामा विकास गरिनेछ । आयोजना विकास सम्झौताअनुसार आयोजनाबाट उत्पादित कुल विद्युत्को २१ प्रतिशत नेपालले निःशुल्क प्राप्त गर्नेछ । आयोजनाको २५ वर्षको व्यावसायिक सञ्चालन अवधि पूरा भएपछि आयोजना नेपाल सरकारलाई निःशुल्क हस्तान्तरण गरिने व्यवस्था छ । तल्लो अरुण जलविद्युत् आयोजना भारतीय सरकारी कम्पनी सतलज जलविद्युत् निगम (एसजेभीएन)को सहायक कम्पनीमार्फत विकास भइरहेको हो । नेपाल सरकारको लगानी बोर्ड र आयोजना विकास कम्पनीबीच सन् २०२३ जुन १ मा आयोजना विकास सम्झौता सम्पन्न भएको थियो । आयोजना अरुण–३ जलविद्युत् आयोजनासँग जोडिएको प्रणालीमा सञ्चालन हुनेछ । अरुण–३ बाट विद्युत् उत्पादनपछि निस्कने पानीलाई करिब १७।३ किलोमिटर लामो सुरुङमार्फत तल्लो अरुणको विद्युत् गृहमा पुर्‍याई थप विद्युत् उत्पादन गर्ने योजना छ । आयोजना निर्माणका लागि जग्गा अधिग्रहण तथा प्रभावित परिवारलाई मुआब्जा वितरणको काम अघि बढाइएको छ । आयोजनाबाट प्रत्यक्ष प्रभावित २६८ परिवार रहेकामा हालसम्म २५३ परिवारलाई करिब रु ९९ करोड ९८ लाख मुआब्जा वितरण गरिएको आयोजना विकास कम्पनीले जनाएको छ । आयोजनाबाट नेपालले निःशुल्क ऊर्जा, रोयल्टी, कर तथा अन्य आर्थिक लाभ प्राप्त गर्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । निर्माणका क्रममा रोजगारी सिर्जना, स्थानीय पूर्वाधार विकास तथा आर्थिक गतिविधि विस्तारमा समेत योगदान पुग्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । New Delhi: Prime Minister Balendra Shah and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi jointly laid the foundation stone of the 669 MW Lower Arun Hydropower Project today. Prime Minister Shah and Indian Prime Minister Modi, who are on a state visit to India, laid the foundation stone of the project through 'virtual' technology. The project, which is being constructed under Nepal-India energy cooperation, is located in Chichila Rural Municipality and Khandbari Municipality of Sankhuwasabha. The estimated cost of the project is Rs 92.67 billion. The target is to complete the construction within five years. The project, which aims to expand energy cooperation between Nepal and India and increase Nepal's hydropower generation capacity, will be developed on a build, own, operate and transfer (BOOT) basis. According to the project development agreement, Nepal will receive 21 percent of the total electricity generated from the project free of charge. There is an arrangement that the project will be handed over to the Government of Nepal free of charge after the completion of the 25-year commercial operation period of the project. The Lower Arun Hydropower Project is being developed through a subsidiary of the Indian government company, Sutlej Hydropower Corporation (SJVN). The project development agreement was concluded between the Investment Board of the Government of Nepal and the project development company on June 1, 2023. The project will operate in a system connected to the Arun-3 Hydropower Project. The plan is to transport the water released from Arun-3 after generating electricity to the Lower Arun Power Plant through a tunnel about 17.3 kilometers long, thereby generating additional electricity. Land acquisition for project construction and distribution of compensation to affected families have been progressed. The project development company has stated that compensation of approximately Rs. 999.8 million has been distributed to 253 families out of 268 families directly affected by the project. Nepal is expected to receive free energy, royalties, taxes, and other economic benefits from the project. It is expected that the construction will also contribute to job creation, local infrastructure development, and economic activity expansion.

सङ्खुवासभाको चिचिला गाउँपालिका र खाँदबारी नगरपालिकामा अवस्थित छ । आयोजनाको अनुमानित लागत रु ९२ अर्ब ६७ करोड रहेको छ । निर्माण पाँच वर्षभित्र सम्पन्न गर्ने लक्ष्य राखिएको छ । नेपाल र भारतबीच ऊर्जा सहकार्य विस्तार तथा नेपालको जलविद्युत् उत्पादन क्षमता वृद्धि गर्ने उद्देश्यले अघि बढाइएको आयोजना निर्माण, स्वामित्व, सञ्चालन तथा हस्तान्तरण (बुट) ढाँचामा विकास गरिनेछ । आयोजना विकास सम्झौताअनुसार आयोजनाबाट उत्पादित कुल विद्युत्को २१ प्रतिशत नेपालले निःशुल्क प्राप्त गर्नेछ । आयोजनाको २५ वर्षको व्यावसायिक सञ्चालन अवधि पूरा भएपछि आयोजना नेपाल सरकारलाई निःशुल्क हस्तान्तरण गरिने व्यवस्था छ । तल्लो अरुण जलविद्युत् आयोजना भारतीय सरकारी कम्पनी सतलज जलविद्युत् निगम (एसजेभीएन)को सहायक कम्पनीमार्फत विकास भइरहेको हो । नेपाल सरकारको लगानी बोर्ड र आयोजना विकास कम्पनीबीच सन् २०२३ जुन १ मा आयोजना विकास सम्झौता सम्पन्न भएको थियो । आयोजना अरुण–३ जलविद्युत् आयोजनासँग जोडिएको प्रणालीमा सञ्चालन हुनेछ । अरुण–३ बाट विद्युत् उत्पादनपछि निस्कने पानीलाई करिब १७।३ किलोमिटर लामो सुरुङमार्फत तल्लो अरुणको विद्युत् गृहमा पुर्‍याई थप विद्युत् उत्पादन गर्ने योजना छ । आयोजना निर्माणका लागि जग्गा अधिग्रहण तथा प्रभावित परिवारलाई मुआब्जा वितरणको काम अघि बढाइएको छ । आयोजनाबाट प्रत्यक्ष प्रभावित २६८ परिवार रहेकामा हालसम्म २५३ परिवारलाई करिब रु ९९ करोड ९८ लाख मुआब्जा वितरण गरिएको आयोजना विकास कम्पनीले जनाएको छ । आयोजनाबाट नेपालले निःशुल्क ऊर्जा, रोयल्टी, कर तथा अन्य आर्थिक लाभ प्राप्त गर्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । निर्माणका क्रममा रोजगारी सिर्जना, स्थानीय पूर्वाधार विकास तथा आर्थिक गतिविधि विस्तारमा समेत योगदान पुग्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । New Delhi: Prime Minister Balendra Shah and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi jointly laid the foundation stone of the 669 MW Lower Arun Hydropower Project today. Prime Minister Shah and Indian Prime Minister Modi, who are on a state visit to India, laid the foundation stone of the project through 'virtual' technology. The project, which is being constructed under Nepal-India energy cooperation, is located in Chichila Rural Municipality and Khandbari Municipality of Sankhuwasabha. The estimated cost of the project is Rs 92.67 billion. The target is to complete the construction within five years. The project, which aims to expand energy cooperation between Nepal and India and increase Nepal's hydropower generation capacity, will be developed on a build, own, operate and transfer (BOOT) basis. According to the project development agreement, Nepal will receive 21 percent of the total electricity generated from the project free of charge. There is an arrangement that the project will be handed over to the Government of Nepal free of charge after the completion of the 25-year commercial operation period of the project. The Lower Arun Hydropower Project is being developed through a subsidiary of the Indian government company, Sutlej Hydropower Corporation (SJVN). The project development agreement was concluded between the Investment Board of the Government of Nepal and the project development company on June 1, 2023. The project will operate in a system connected to the Arun-3 Hydropower Project. The plan is to transport the water released from Arun-3 after generating electricity to the Lower Arun Power Plant through a tunnel about 17.3 kilometers long, thereby generating additional electricity. Land acquisition for project construction and distribution of compensation to affected families have been progressed. The project development company has stated that compensation of approximately Rs. 999.8 million has been distributed to 253 families out of 268 families directly affected by the project. Nepal is expected to receive free energy, royalties, taxes, and other economic benefits from the project. It is expected that the construction will also contribute to job creation, local infrastructure development, and economic activity expansion.

तल्लो अरुण जलविद्युत् आयोजना भारतीय सरकारी कम्पनी सतलज जलविद्युत् निगम (एसजेभीएन)को सहायक कम्पनीमार्फत विकास भइरहेको हो ।

नेपाल सरकारको लगानी बोर्ड र आयोजना विकास कम्पनीबीच सन् २०२३ जुन १ मा आयोजना विकास सम्झौता सम्पन्न भएको थियो ।

आयोजना अरुण–३ जलविद्युत् आयोजनासँग जोडिएको प्रणालीमा सञ्चालन हुनेछ । अरुण–३ बाट विद्युत् उत्पादनपछि निस्कने पानीलाई करिब १७।३ किलोमिटर लामो सुरुङमार्फत तल्लो अरुणको विद्युत् गृहमा पुर्‍याई थप विद्युत् उत्पादन गर्ने योजना छ ।

आयोजना निर्माणका लागि जग्गा अधिग्रहण तथा प्रभावित परिवारलाई मुआब्जा वितरणको काम अघि बढाइएको छ ।

आयोजनाबाट प्रत्यक्ष प्रभावित २६८ परिवार रहेकामा हालसम्म २५३ परिवारलाई करिब रु ९९ करोड ९८ लाख मुआब्जा वितरण गरिएको आयोजना विकास कम्पनीले जनाएको छ ।

आयोजनाबाट नेपालले निःशुल्क ऊर्जा, रोयल्टी, कर तथा अन्य आर्थिक लाभ प्राप्त गर्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ ।

निर्माणका क्रममा रोजगारी सिर्जना, स्थानीय पूर्वाधार विकास तथा आर्थिक गतिविधि विस्तारमा समेत योगदान पुग्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ ।

New Delhi: Prime Minister Balendra Shah and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi jointly laid the foundation stone of the 669 MW Lower Arun Hydropower Project today. Prime Minister Shah and Indian Prime Minister Modi, who are on a state visit to India, laid the foundation stone of the project through 'virtual' technology. The project, which is being constructed under Nepal-India energy cooperation, is located in Chichila Rural Municipality and Khandbari Municipality of Sankhuwasabha. The estimated cost of the project is Rs 92.67 billion. The target is to complete the construction within five years. The project, which aims to expand energy cooperation between Nepal and India and increase Nepal's hydropower generation capacity, will be developed on a build, own, operate and transfer (BOOT) basis. According to the project development agreement, Nepal will receive 21 percent of the total electricity generated from the project free of charge. There is an arrangement that the project will be handed over to the Government of Nepal free of charge after the completion of the 25-year commercial operation period of the project. The Lower Arun Hydropower Project is being developed through a subsidiary of the Indian government company, Sutlej Hydropower Corporation (SJVN). The project development agreement was concluded between the Investment Board of the Government of Nepal and the project development company on June 1, 2023. The project will operate in a system connected to the Arun-3 Hydropower Project. The plan is to transport the water released from Arun-3 after generating electricity to the Lower Arun Power Plant through a tunnel about 17.3 kilometers long, thereby generating additional electricity. Land acquisition for project construction and distribution of compensation to affected families have been progressed. The project development company has stated that compensation of approximately Rs. 999.8 million has been distributed to 253 families out of 268 families directly affected by the project. Nepal is expected to receive free energy, royalties, taxes, and other economic benefits from the project. It is expected that the construction will also contribute to job creation, local infrastructure development, and economic activity expansion.
